name: Codeinone
summary: Codeinone is an isoquinolone alkaloid found in the opium poppy. As an analgesic, it is one-third the potency of codeine. It is an important intermediate in the production of hydrocodone–a painkiller about three-quarters the potency of morphine–as well as of oxycodone, though the latter can also be synthesized from thebaine.

pharmacology.en: It is a weak opioid that acts at opioid receptors, but it has been little studied as a drug in its own right.
pharmacology.zh: 它是作用於鴉片類受體的弱效鴉片類物質，但很少被當作獨立藥物研究。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是作用于鸦片类受体的弱效鸦片类物质，但很少被当作独立药物研究。

uses.en: It has no medical use of its own. It is an important intermediate in making hydrocodone and oxycodone.
uses.zh: 它本身沒有醫療用途，但它是製造氫可酮與羥考酮的重要中間體。
uses.zhHans: 它本身没有医疗用途，但它是制造氢可酮与羟考酮的重要中间体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids in general cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。一般來說，鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，過量時可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。一般来说，鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，过量时可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止。

fact.en: In the opium poppy, codeinone is one step on the plant's route to morphine: thebaine is turned into codeinone, then codeine, and finally morphine.
fact.zh: 在罌粟中，可待因酮是植物合成嗎啡途徑中的一步：蒂巴因先轉化成可待因酮，再變成可待因，最後成為嗎啡。
fact.zhHans: 在罂粟中，可待因酮是植物合成吗啡途径中的一步：蒂巴因先转化成可待因酮，再变成可待因，最后成为吗啡。
